<thought>To obtain the precursors for the template 149040, we need the substrate (the molecule that will be silylated) and the silyl‑sulfonyl fluoride reagent. The substrate is the first SMILES from the previous step, and the reagent corresponds to the SMARTS in the mapped reaction, which without atom‑mapping is “O=S(=O)(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(F)(F)F”. Therefore the only possible precursor combination is these two molecules.</thought>
<final_answer>[["O=CHCH2C1O[C@H](/C=C(C)CCH2OH)", "O=S(=O)(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(F)(F)F"]]</final_answer>
